boardEligibilityNotice: Completing this independent course conveys no ABPN eligibility. Refer to ABPN current eligibility rules.

boardStatus.status: Surgical pathology fellowship training is not itself a distinct ABPath board-certification category. ABPath publishes primary Anatomic Pathology content specifications and lists its subspecialty examinations; surgical pathology is not among the separate subspecialty examinations. This course maps to AP domains and relevant competency concepts only; it is not a board-preparation guarantee.
boardStatus.institutionalTrackDistinction: The MGB Surgical Pathology Fellowship page describes broad general surgical pathology across MGH and BWH with frozen-section experience and electives. A distinct MGH Surgical Pathology Signout Fellowship is explicitly described as non-ACGME under the MGB Education Committee. The MGH page states that combined MGB surgical pathology fellowships at MGH and BWH will be offered with ACGME accreditation starting July 2027. This future announcement is not proof of current accreditation, and should be checked against ACGME ADS for the cohort in question.
boardStatus.blueprintScope: Current ABPath AP content specifications are the closest published board framework. ACGME recognizes Selective Pathology as a program category, but it is not synonymous with either institutional offering and does not establish a separate surgical-pathology examination. Unit mappings below are study-domain crosswalks, not an official ABPath weighting.

boardEligibilityNotice: This independent educational course confers no eligibility to enter a fellowship, no ACGME training credit, and no ABPath exam eligibility. ABPath certification depends on qualifying medical education, accredited pathology training, licensure and other current board requirements. Fellowship admission conditions differ by offering. MGH currently describes completed AP or AP/CP residency and Massachusetts medical-license eligibility for its signout fellowship. Verify current requirements with each institution and ABPath; no qualification, diagnosis, case volume, passing score or certification is promised.

boardNames: American Board of Pathology (ABPath) — Medical Microbiology subspecialty certification
American Board of Medical Microbiology (ABMM) — separate doctoral-level certification; not an ABPath/ABMS subspecialty exam
boardStatus: A separate ABPath Medical Microbiology subspecialty examination exists (one-day, 305 one-best-answer questions, 6 hours 10 minutes as currently described). ABMM is a separate certification for doctoral-level laboratory microbiologists. Eligibility for either board is determined by that board and the applicant pathway; this course confers none. The MGB fellowship is a clinical physician training programme and does not itself state that every track/candidate automatically qualifies for either examination.
boardEligibilityNotice: MGB lists eligible/certified AP/CP/combined pathology candidates or internal medicine/pediatrics graduates who complete ACGME-accredited Infectious Diseases fellowship; applicants must be eligible for Massachusetts medical licensure. Confirm current ABPath primary-certification and subspecialty eligibility directly with ABPath. CPEP-to-ABMM eligibility is a separate route; do not infer ABMM eligibility from this MGB programme.

boardNames: American Board of Surgery (ABS) — Adult Complex Thyroid and Parathyroid Surgery Focused Practice Designation (ACTPS FPD)
American Board of Otolaryngology–Head and Neck Surgery (ABOHNS) — collaborating board for the ABS ACTPS FPD; no standalone ABOHNS endocrine surgery subspecialty exam identified
boardStatus: The MEE offering is an AHNS-accredited one-year clinical fellowship, not itself a board certification or separate board examination. ABS/ABOHNS jointly developed an Adult Complex Thyroid and Parathyroid Surgery Focused Practice Designation examination. ABS describes the FPD as an added designation in an area not already recognized by specialty/subspecialty certification. The FPD is not automatic fellowship completion; ABS eligibility includes primary ABS certification and clinical experience/case requirements, which may change. ABOHNS primary/subspecialty certification remains separate. No separate thyroid/parathyroid surgeon board was found.
boardEligibilityNotice: This independent self-study confers no board eligibility. ABS FPD eligibility is governed solely by current ABS requirements and may involve primary certification, experience logs, current unrestricted license and an examination. The fellowship page’s eligibility language is not a board eligibility determination. ABOHNS certification eligibility must be checked with ABOHNS. No guarantee of exam admission or passing.

American Board of Plastic Surgery (ABPS) — primary board route named by ABFPRS
Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Canada (RCPSC) — pathway named by ABFPRS; verify current jurisdictional rules
boardStatus: A distinct ABFPRS certification and exam exist. Current public requirements include eligible primary training/certification, two years in practice, 100 accepted operative reports, an eight-hour written/oral examination, accredited facility, appropriate licensure and its code of ethics. Exam-development page describes 300 written MCQs and oral examination of 12 cosmetic/reconstructive patient problems. No public weighted blueprint was identified; course domains are not official categories. ABFPRS is not listed in the ABMS Member Board roster checked 2026-10-07. ACGME Plastic Surgery lists Hand Surgery and Craniofacial Plastic Surgery; that page does not establish MEE fellowship status or status in another specialty. AAFPRS Foundation has a separate fellowship framework; do not equate it with ACGME accreditation or ABMS board status.
boardEligibilityNotice: This self-study course supplies no MD/DO, residency, ACGME/RCPSC training, fellowship appointment/certificate, operative experience/log, two years in practice, peer review, license, accredited facility, application eligibility or certification. Confirm current pathway with ABFPRS, primary board, AAFPRS, programme and regulators. Completion cannot guarantee eligibility or passing.
